title: Formaldehyde: FDA Regulatory Status, State Bans & Global Restrictions
excerpt: Formaldehyde is an IARC Group 1 carcinogen facing an accelerating patchwork of state bans in cosmetics, a repeatedly delayed federal proposed rule, active mass tort litigation with 11,400+ pending cases, and an August 2026 EU REACH deadline. Here is what FDA-regulated companies need to know.
